title: Q3 Forge: Cohort-based roadmap scaffold for Hosted API & Model Catalog
creator: Marisol Ortega
description: Build a quadrant/cohort-based roadmap scaffold that ties Hosted API feature lanes to model-catalog operational readiness and capacity hedges. This ticket formalizes a playbook for grouping customers and endpoints into cohorts (pilot, growth, enterprise, regulated) and mapping each cohort to explicit model variants, rollout windows, and capacity commitments. The goal is to produce a prioritized, executable Q3 roadmap that surfaces trade-offs between latency SLO, cost per token, and model quality, and that can be handed to Eng/Design/Reliability for implementation planning.
acceptance_criteria: Cohorts defined with quantitative criteria and representative customer examples
Mapping table that assigns model-family variants and serving profiles to each cohort
Capacity hedging plan with burst vs reserved guidance and estimated GPU-hours by cohort
Canary windows and rollback criteria documented for each cohort
Cross-functional sign-off (PM, Eng, Design, Reliability) captured in meeting notes
comments: 2026-03-02 - Kickoff meeting: aligned on cohort definitions (pilot, growth, enterprise, regulated). Action: PM to draft mapping template and ask Eng for baseline latency/cost per model variant.
2026-03-05 - Eng feedback: need to validate KV cache hit assumptions for enterprise cohort; recommended synthetic load tests before final capacity numbers. Added ENG-2729 as dependency.
2026-03-09 - Design review: dashboard mockups requested to surface cohort-level SLOs and cost burn; agreed to prototype a per-cohort view in Console mockups (Design owners: Priya Shah).

2026-03-12 - Trade-off note: preferring reserved capacity for enterprise/regulation cohorts increases fixed cost but simplifies compliance; growth cohort should default to burstable dedicated pools to optimize unit economics.
2026-03-14 - Draft mapping uploaded to Drive: https://drive.re/redwood/q3-forge-cohorts (internal). Action: Eng to supply GPU-hour estimates by 2026-03-20.
2026-03-15 - Stakeholder sync: Reliability flagged a fallback policy gap for multi-region rollouts; adding follow-up subtask to enumerate fallback-compatible model variants.
decisions: Adopt cohort scaffold over a single master roadmap to allow staggered rollouts and capacity optimization
Use three model-variant tiers (fast-low-cost, balanced, high-quality) and expose mapping in Console
Require synthetic KV-cache hit-rate validation before committing reserved capacity for enterprise cohort
next_steps: PM to finalize cohort quantitative thresholds and publish mapping template (due 2026-03-18)
Eng to run synthetic load tests and return GPU-hour estimates (due 2026-03-20)
Design to prototype cohort dashboard and share for review (due 2026-03-22)
Schedule cross-functional sign-off meeting the week of 2026-03-23
